sources.title: NAS Parallel Benchmarks
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ReproZip：依賴閉包與可重現封裝缺口
related.titleEn: ReproZip: dependency closure and reproducible-package gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩人得到同一群組與1.8、2.0；報告不把三次合成樣本當官方NPB結果或完整機器效能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both reviewers recover the same groups and ratios; the report does not present synthetic repeats as official NPB results or overall machine performance.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ReproZip：依賴閉包與可重現封裝缺口」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付required、observed、packaged三份manifest及差集；標明ReproZip trace需Linux，這個離線紙面實驗本身可跨平台重作。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ReproZip: dependency closure and reproducible-package gaps using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver separate required, observed and packaged manifests with their differences. Distinguish the Linux tracing requirement of ReproZip from this portable offline manifest exercise, and retain a record of deliberate exclusions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 建立四筆候選紀錄，保留3秒失敗資料；分開記錄exit code、verification狀態及計時是否完整，避免以單一success布林覆蓋三者。
為27個已封裝檔建立ID、路徑、大小、hash四欄；加入一個同名不同hash與一個不同路徑同內容別名，分別檢查錯誤接受與重複計數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Create the four candidate records, including the failed 3-second observation. Record exit status, numerical verification and completeness of the timed interval separately so that one success flag cannot erase their different meanings.

Create ID, path, size and hash columns for the twenty-seven packaged matches. Add a same-name hash mismatch and a different-path alias of identical content to challenge both false acceptance and accidental double counting.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Frontier：GPU—NIC 路徑的流量加權驗收
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩人得到同一群組與1.8、2.0；報告不把三次合成樣本當官方NPB結果或完整機器效能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both reviewers recover the same groups and ratios; the report does not present synthetic repeats as official NPB results or overall machine performance.
related.difference: 建立 gpu_uuid、nic、numa、bytes 四欄關聯表，再與來源的拓撲敘述分開保存；記錄作業配置來源而非猜測裝置排序。
related.differenceEn: Build topology.json keyed by stable GPU identity and a separate placement.csv keyed by rank. Join through explicit identifiers and record where each relation came from; reject a flow whose GPU or NIC is missing.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 建立四筆候選紀錄，保留3秒失敗資料；分開記錄exit code、verification狀態及計時是否完整，避免以單一success布林覆蓋三者。
將每條流的位元組乘上遠端路徑指示值，再求和。這是跨 NUMA 資料量，不能直接換算成延遲或硬體損耗；八條流各 8 GiB；名義配置兩條遠端，變更配置六條遠端；流量總和皆為 64 GiB；名義式 2*8 = 16 GiB；變更式 6*8 = 48 GiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Create the four candidate records, including the failed 3-second observation. Record exit status, numerical verification and completeness of the timed interval separately so that one success flag cannot erase their different meanings.

Sum each flow size multiplied by its remote-path indicator. This measures bytes assigned to remote paths, not observed link congestion, elapsed time, or a vendor bandwidth specification. Construct flows.csv with eight flows of 8 GiB, stable GPU UUIDs, NIC names and NUMA labels. The nominal assignment has two remote flows; the changed assignment has six. Total traffic remains 64 GiB. Nominal 2*8 = 16 GiB; changed 6*8 = 48 GiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
